audit.whatIsWrong: Both level charts disagree with the packet AND with their own why-text. Content had Kayle winning levels 3 and 4-5 while the whys under them say 'you scale faster', 'you win every extended trade'. The full layer had Gragas winning level 1 outright while the content why calls it a wash.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Gragas/Gragas/Gragas/Gragas/Kayle/Kayle and that is exactly what the prose already argues: melee Kayle with no sustain and no waveclear loses levels 2-6, then ranged form and two items flip it.
audit.corrected: Both charts flipped as one atomic group to Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Kayle, Kayle, with phases[0], [1] and [5] why-text rewritten to match their new side.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike windows were named but carried no cooldowns, and 'a whiffed E is 13 seconds' misstates Body Slam.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — 14s at rank 1. Divine Judgment is 160/120/80, so at 6 it is a 160s cooldown and baiting it once buys nearly three minutes of free aggression. Radiant Blast is 12s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Divine Judgment's 160s, Radiant Blast's 12s and Body Slam's 14s written into the cooldown block, the don'ts and the trading rules.

audit.whatIsWrong: The interactions text was generic filler with the wrong pronoun ('W as he answers', 'his key tool'), and never stated the two interactions that actually decide the lane: Radiant Blast shredding resistances into her follow-up, and Divine Judgment making the target untargetable so a committed Explosive Cask is wasted.
audit.why: Riot's text: Radiant Blast slows and reduces the resistances of everything it pierces, so her Q is the opener that makes the rest hurt — dodging it defuses the whole trade. Divine Judgment grants invulnerability, so Cask thrown into it costs 100s for nothing. Body Slam collides with the FIRST enemy unit it meets, so a minion between you and Kayle eats the engage entirely — she never has to dodge it, she just has to stand behind the wave.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, resistance shred named, and the minion-block on Body Slam plus the untargetable-eats-Cask rule written into trading and the don'ts.
